in_arabic.name: نوران
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word for light, which is نور (nur). The suffix '-an' is added to create a feminine form, resulting in the name نوران (Nouran).

in_urdu.name: نوران
in_urdu.long_meaning: A name derived from the Urdu word for light, which is نور (nur). The suffix '-an' is added to create a feminine form, resulting in the name نوران (Nouran).

in_hindi.name: दिपक
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hindi word for light, which is दिप (deep). The name Lyana can be approximated as 'Lya-na', which can be interpreted as 'Light' in Hindi, hence the name दिपक (Dipak).

in_pashto.name: لارا
